sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.description: High-illumination ridge linking Shackleton crater with de Gerlache. A leading candidate because it combines long solar exposure with a short path to permanently shadowed terrain.

sites.name: Apollo 11 — Mare Tranquillitatis
sites.description: Equatorial control site (0.674 N, 23.473 E). Its analytic flat horizon isolates the effect of the Moon's 1.54-degree axial tilt and exposes how different the polar lighting geometry is.
